_readme: Fill this in ONCE for your environment. Every script reads the values it needs from here when you don't pass them on the command line. Empty string or empty list = not set (the script then behaves as documented, asks, or skips). Explicit command-line parameters always win. Relative file paths are relative to this Config folder. See README.md in this folder.

Company._used_by: Set-Branding (About page support info), New-DesktopShortcuts (via desktop-shortcuts.json)

Branding._used_by: Set-Branding. Drop the files in Config\Branding\ with these names; a missing file is skipped.

ActiveDirectory._used_by: New-ADUserOnboard, New-BulkADUsers, Disable-ADUserOffboard, New-EmployeeOnboard, Disable-EmployeeOffboard, Join-Domain, Test-ADHealth, Deploy-GPOCentralStore, Get-ADPasswordExpiry

Desktop._used_by: Set-DesktopExperience, Set-StartTaskbarLayout, New-DesktopShortcuts. Theme: Dark / Light / Skip. IconSize: Small / Medium / Large / Skip. Pins: AUMIDs or exe/.lnk paths (Get-StartApps lists AUMIDs).

Regional._used_by: Set-RegionalSettings, Initialize-NewPC. Belgian Dutch defaults; French site: fr-BE + 080c:0000080c.

Power._used_by: Set-PowerAndLock. Plan: Balanced / HighPerformance / Skip. Minutes: -1 = leave as is, 0 = never. LockAfterMinutes 0 = don't change.

Alerting._used_by: Send-ToolkitAlert, Invoke-HealthCheck, Install-HealthCheckTask, Install-AllScheduledTasks. Prefer 19-Secrets for the webhook if this folder is readable by non-admins.

Monitoring._used_by: Install-ZabbixAgent, Invoke-HealthCheck (extra services that must run), and the planned fleet/Zabbix integration (NEXT.md 0.1/0.2). Nothing about Zabbix is hardcoded in the kit: the server address, the web/API URL and the host names all come from here (or from the command line), so the same kit works against any Zabbix - lab today, the employer's tomorrow, one per customer later. Put the API token in 19-Secrets, not here.

Security._used_by: Get-LocalAdminAudit (accounts that are allowed in local Administrators), Get-FirewallAuditReport

Reports._used_by: Every report script: where HTML/CSV reports go when you don't pass -OutputPath. Empty = the kit's Reports folder.
